senses.gloss:
शोपारीपाक शोपारी-पाक, a particular me-
dicinal decoction.

सोपकरण सोपकरण (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
provided with every requisite instrument or imple-
ment, properly equipped.

सोपकार (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with
necessary means or implements, well equipped or
stocked; assisted, befriended.

सोपकारक (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, properly equipped
or aided, assisted, benefited.

सोपचार सोपचार (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, act-
ing with politeness or civility, deferential; (अम्), n.
politely, deferentially.

सोपचारकम् (स-उप्˚), ind. politely, deferen-
tially.

सोपद्रव सोपद्रव (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
visited with great calamities or afflictions, dangerous.

सोपध सोपध (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, full of
fraud or deceit, fraudulent, guileful.

सोपधि, इस्, इस्, इ, fraudulent; (इ), ind. deceitfully,
fraudulently.

सोपाधि सोपाधि, इस्, इस्, इ, or सोपाधिक (स-
उप्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, restricted by some condition or
limitation, limited, qualified by some particular cha-
racteristic (as liberality by the desire of receiving
something in return); having some peculiar attri-
bute or distinguishing title; special.

सोपनिषत्क सोपनिषत्क (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
along with the Upaniṣads, (Kullūka on Manu II.
165.)

सोपप्लव सोपप्लव (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, af-
flicted with any great calamity, overrun or attacked
by enemies; eclipsed (as the sun or moon).

सोपरोध सोपरोध (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ob-
structed, impeded; favoured; (अम्), ind. obligingly,
respectfully.

सोपवास सोपवास or सोपवासिक (स-उप्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, fasting, keeping a fast.

सोपसर्ग सोपसर्ग (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, af-
flicted with any great misfortune, visited by portents,
portentous; possessed by an evil spirit; having a
particle, preceded by a prepositional prefix (in gram-
mar).

सोपहास सोपहास (स-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ac-
companied with derisive laughter, sneering, jocular,
sarcastic; (अम्), ind. with a sneer, sneeringly.
—सोप-
हासोत्प्रास (˚स-उत्˚), अस्, m. a jocular expression.

सोपाक सोपाक, अस्, m. (probably another
form of श्व-पाक), a man of a degraded caste (the
son of a Cāṇḍāla by a Pukkasī, and only to be em-
ployed as a public executioner, &c., see Manu X. 38).

सोपान सोपान, अम्, n. (perhaps contracted
from स + उपायन), stairs, steps, a staircase, a
ladder.
—सोपान-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition
of stairs, the uses of a staircase.
—सोपान-परम्-
परा, f. a line of steps, flight of steps.

सोपानत्क सोपानत्क, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. स +
उपानह् + क, see उपा-नह्), with sandals, having
sandals or shoes, (Manu III. 238.)

सोपासन सोपासन (स-उप्˚), अस्, m. having
the sacred fire, (see 2. उपासन.)
